metadata.description: Adversarial second-opinion code review: GPT reviews Claude's diff before a coding task is reported done. Consent-first, best-effort secret redaction, optional enforcement hook.

plugins.name: gpt-review
plugins.description: Before Claude hands work back, send the git diff to GPT (your own OpenAI key) for adversarial review. Privacy-first: sensitive files excluded, secrets redacted (best-effort), --dry-run preview, first-run consent. Optional Stop hook for deterministic enforcement.
